violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.205(b))
violation_type.short_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance
violation_type.typical_finding: The annual insurance verification due date was 5/2/2025. This was corrected at inspection when the director verified the insurance on the provider portal.

finding_variants.text: The annual insurance verification due date was 5/2/2025. This was corrected at inspection when the director verified the insurance on the provider portal.
The operation did not provide written notification to verify the absence of liability insurance. This notification was due 2/26/2026.
Written notification of the operation no longer carrying liability insurance was not received.
The annual notification for lack of liability insurance was not completed by 09/14/2024.
The operation does not have a current annual verification of liability insurance. The operation has a next annual verification past due date of 2/9/2026.
The operation does not have a current annual verification of liability insurance. The operation has a next annual verification past due date of 7/1/2025.
